passkey.delete_body: This item holds a passkey for {site}. {site} still has the public key of the passkey: when you no longer need it, remove it at {site} too. This device keeps the item and its passkey in the trash for 30 days, and restoring the item brings the passkey back; it signs you in again only while {site} still has the public key. The deletion reaches every device.
passkey.delete_many_body: Passkeys among these items: {passkeys}, for {sites}. Those sites still have the public keys: when you no longer need a passkey, remove it at its site too. This device keeps the items and their passkeys in the trash for 30 days, and restoring an item brings its passkey back; it signs you in again only while its site still has the public key. The deletion reaches every device.
passkey.edit_note: This item holds a passkey for {site}. It is kept when you save. To remove it, use Remove passkey on the item page.
passkey.heading: Passkey
passkey.kind_help: Ferret keeps the key encrypted in your vault and uses it to sign you in to the site in the browser extension. The key is never shown here.
passkey.remove_body: The item stays, but its passkey is deleted from your vault and can no longer sign you in to {site} with Ferret. {site} still has the public key of the passkey. Remove the passkey at {site} too, in your account there, so that it does not stay as a way to sign in that nobody can use.
passkey.removed: The passkey for {site} was removed from the item.
passkey.trash_note: Holds a passkey for {site}. Restoring the item brings the passkey back as it was.
passkey.trash_unregistered: If Ferret moved this item here itself because saving the passkey did not finish, the passkey is not registered at {site} and cannot sign you in there.
